items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: Or you had such celebrities as Trixie Ferganza and Lou Hearn, all big time star acts. And we were supposed to be on the stage with them.

ctx.x: Well, uh, Arnold, when, uh, when y'all went to New York, where'd you open up there?

Well, we, we went to New York. We were supposed to be in a town topic show. Or you had such celebrities as Trixie Ferganza and Lou Hearn, all big time star acts. And we were supposed to be on the stage with them. However, when we got there, we were supposed to be in a show. And I called these fellas' attention to the fact. I said, well, there's your Harry Fitzgerald. I said, you're supposed to be in the show. You're working in a restaurant. It was a monstrous place. The Century Theater. It was up at, uh, 62nd and…
getting lost in the joint. But you're all hooking up in the restaurant instead of on the stage.
